scope: Static source and content checks only. This does not prove browser behavior or visual quality.

checks.name: All HTML content keys exist in both languages
English and Chinese use the same content keys
Three bilingual meetings share task counts, names and initial states
Five official FAQs and six revision FAQs in each language
Revision price and both subtitles updated independently
Copy documents reflect official and revision price/subtitle/FAQ
All local stylesheet, scripts, icon and anchor targets exist
No external resources, fetch, module imports or local storage

revision.enSubtitleBefore: Turn meeting notes into a clear summary, decisions, and tasks—so everyone knows what comes next, and who owns it.
revision.enSubtitleAfter: Bring meeting context, decisions, and clear ownership together—then use one shared view to plan the follow-up.
revision.zhSubtitleBefore: 把会议笔记整理成摘要、决策和任务，让每个人都知道接下来做什么、由谁负责。
revision.zhSubtitleAfter: 把会议背景、决策和任务分工放在一起，让团队通过同一份清楚的记录安排后续工作。
